images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 418 Western A

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a two-storey flat-roofed two-flat with stacked porches -- a balcony with a spindle rail over a deep ground-floor porch with rocking chairs; tight to the houses on both sides, under big trees

why.note: the stacked two-flat: an owner below and a tenant above on one narrow lot
